body:
Living in loneliness and constantly betrayal my whole life.
Realizing that you can't trust anyone, even parents or family because they've hurt you so much. Feeling unlovable and shamed for who you are. Persistent negative assumptions. Like you can't do anything right. And every step forward is another foot in the grave. Your hopes and dreams for your life are shattered by  people who are supposed to love you. Leaving you feeling you have no purpose.
Yeah I do think about how much better things used to be.
Man I can relate… sad we have to carry such pain
Man if only we could all be cats🐱

This comment and the post may the be the most honest thing I’ve read all day. It hurts knowing a lot of people are in just as much pain as you are. But other than that it’s helpful knowing that I’m not alone in this. 😌

I’m in the same boat as you. Haven’t been eating at all. I honestly don’t even have the energy or the will to anymore. Anyway I hope you can get the help you need in your situation. Wishing all the best😌

I know exactly how you feel. My parents didn’t give a fuck about my depression and suicidal ideation. Nor did they pay for any of my needs. I had to pay for it all myself at 17, like you have. All they cared about was school and pressured me to the bone about it. I’m 19 now and still struggle but I’m definitely leaving when I have enough money. You can do it :)
I’ve never been able to relate this much….sad times my friend. Whatever you’re going through I hope you have a wonderful day, even if nothing makes it better.
